# pages.yml

<link-summary>Inputs, secrets and outputs of the reusable workflow GitHub Pages.</link-summary>

```text
Assembles the GitHub Pages site from every part the run produced (writerside.yml, dartdoc.yml,
flutter-build.yml web builds, the coverage and Inspectra reports) and deploys it. A repository
has exactly one site, so this is the only workflow that deploys; call it after the producers.

The caller grants pages: write and id-token: write. The github-pages environment only allows
the default branch unless its deployment rules say otherwise.
```

```yaml
jobs:
  pages:
    uses: davils-com/workflows/.github/workflows/pages.yml@v1
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | string | `{"docs":"/","api":"/api","web":"/app/{id}","coverage":"/coverage/{id}","inspectra":"/quality"}` | JSON object mapping a part (docs, api, web, coverage, inspectra) to its path; {id} is the id of the part. |
| `landing-page` | string | `auto` | auto (when no part provides /index.html), true or false. |
| `cname` | string | empty | Custom domain of the site. |
| `spa-fallback` | string | empty | Id of a web part whose index.html also serves as 404.html, for client side routing. |
| `extra-path` | string | empty | Directory of the repository copied into the site root. |
| `title` | string | empty | Title of the landing page; empty uses the repository name. |
| `deploy-enabled` | boolean | `true` | Deploy the site; false only assembles and uploads it. |
| `environment` | string | `github-pages` | Name of the deployment environment. |
| `runners` | string | `{}` | JSON object of runner labels. |
| `harden-runner` | boolean | `true` | Run step-security/harden-runner first. |
| `harden-runner-egress-policy` | string | `audit` | audit or block. |
| `harden-runner-allowed-endpoints` | string | empty | Endpoints allowed with the block policy, space separated. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `url` | The URL of the deployed site. |

## Permissions the caller grants

- `contents: read`
- `id-token: write`
- `pages: write`
